title: MythicWeb Lite
description: MythicWeb Lite Ver.1.0 [1.21+] - Realtime Web Dashboard & Inventory Viewer Tag Line: Manage your players, view inventories, and monitor your server from a modern web interface.
body:
# Release Notes: MythicWeb Ultimate (Lite) v1.0.0
**Release Date:** January 20, 2026
**Compatible Versions:** Minecraft 1.21.1+

**We are proud to announce the first public release of MythicWeb Ultimate!**
This lightweight web dashboard allows server owners to monitor and manage their server directly from a browser with zero lag.

### ✨ New Features
* **Web Dashboard:** A modern, dark-themed dashboard to view server health and player status.
* **Real-time Stats:** Added monitoring cards for **CPU Load**, **RAM Usage**, **Storage**, and **Uptime**.
* **Inventory Inspector:**
* View player inventory in real-time.
* Accurate slot mapping (Armor, Offhand, and Hotbar).
* Ender Chest viewer support.
* **Admin Management:**
* Added buttons for **Kick**, **Ban**, **Kill**, **Heal**, **Feed**, and **Whitelist**.
* Send direct messages to players via the web.
* **1.21.11 Support:**
* Full support for new items including **Mace**, **Wind Charge**, and the new **Spear**.
* Updated material database for 1.21+ blocks.
* **Smart Image Loading:**
* Implemented an asynchronous image loader to prevent dashboard flickering.
* Added auto-fallback to 3D renders for complex items (Shields, Beds, Skulls).

### Improvements
* Optimized JSON API performance to reduce server TPS impact.
* Improved item categorization in the Spawner menu (Weapon, Tool, Food, Redstone, etc.).
* Added a manual **"Refresh"** button to the inventory panel for better performance control.

### ⚠️ Known Limitations (Lite Version)
* **Custom Textures:** Custom items (MythicMobs/Oraxen) will display as their vanilla base material.
* **Interaction:** Inventory editing, Enchanting, and Item Spawning are **View-Only** in this Lite version.
* **Modded Items:** Forge/Fabric mod items are not supported.
